description: This file is a FastAPI router module for messaging-related endpoints, managing conversations and messages in a chat system. It includes functions for creating conversations, listing user conversations, and retrieving messages within a conversation.

methods.description: Logs messaging-related activities into the audit logs table.

methods.description: Creates a new 1:1 conversation between the current user and another user, after verifying messaging consent, and records the event in audit logs.

methods.name: list_conversations( user: UserMe = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of conversations involving the current user, ordered by creation time descending.

methods.description: Lists messages in a specified conversation, ensuring the current user is a participant.
